_status: BLOCKED — hosted model roles are UNPINNED. No API keys were provisioned in Phase 0 (the human declined paid keys). Guardrail §1.6 forbids guessing a model ID, so every hosted `id` below is null, not a remembered string. The `brief_candidate_sep2026` field records what the brief proposed, purely as a starting point for live verification when keys exist.
_verification_procedure: Set OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, then run the §10.2 procedure: list live models, pick the current ID (or the documented successor), make one minimal call per role (1 token in, <=16 out), save the response to docs/setup/model-smoke/<role>.json, and write the returned response id into verified_by.

judge_strong.note: Must be cross-provider relative to the generator under test (skill rag-eval-protocol).

judge_fast.note: ci_approved may only become true after >=0.8 agreement with the strong judge AND human labels on 60-100 double-labeled items.

embeddings_local.rationale: Chosen over all-MiniLM-L6-v2: stronger retrieval quality on MTEB at comparable size and speed, 384 dims keeps the pgvector index small, and it runs comfortably on a 2-vCPU CPU-only box. Full ADR due in the build phase.

reranker_local.threshold_check: PASS — 4.56 ms/pair is well under the 50 ms/pair limit in §10.2, so the heavier BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 remains a viable build-phase A/B arm rather than being ruled out on latency.
reranker_local.rationale: Fast, CPU-friendly, well-established baseline cross-encoder. Quality A/B against bge-reranker-v2-m3 is a build-phase ADR.

_hardware_context.note: All local timings measured on the Phase 0 box and are not portable.
